title: R2 cleanup: delete the 7 weights no build from 1.5.0 on installs (81.1 GB: Wan 2.2 t2v pair, LTX fp8/mxfp8, three H3 turbo LoRAs)
description: Found by the 2026-10-11 R2 audit (Fabio: bill ~$7.8/mo on 532.7 GB and rising; approved all 7). SUPPORT FLOOR (Fabio 2026-10-11): 1.5.0 is the oldest build kept working - anything only a pre-1.5.0 build installs may be deleted. GROUP 1, R2-only (master has no URL for it): vision/models/loras/minimax-h3/minimax_h3_fl2v_lightx2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfy.safetensors (1.96 GB), last INSTALLED by v1.4.4 (v1.5.0 only keeps its dep entry). GROUP 2, deprecated dep entries master keeps for the orphan sweep: wan-22-t2v-high/low (MPI-470, 29.1 GB, last installed v1.3.1), ltx23-transformer-fp8/mxfp8 (MPI-466, 49.3 GB, last v1.3.1), minimax-h3-turbo-lora v1.0 (0.44 GB) and minimax-h3-ref2va-turbo-lora v0.1 (0.31 GB) (no build back to v1.4.2 names either). Steps: (1) KEEP the six group-2 DEPS entries but drop their url/mirrorUrl, leaving the old URLs in a comment, exactly as MPI-698 did for qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq (assetDeps.js ~1181-1241) - scripts/check-dep-urls.mjs HEADs every DEPS url, so deleting the object while url stays turns release:check red; check nothing else reads dep.url unguarded; ship that commit and see CI green. (2) rclone deletefile --s3-no-check-bucket all 7 keys (group 1 can go first, it needs no code), verify with rclone lsl. (3) HF mirror copies (Wan t2v pair on Mad-Pony-Interactive/cubric-studio): Fabio's call, R2 only was approved. Not in scope: klein-lora-outpaint (v1.5.0 installs it, MPI-603), boogu-qwen3vl-8b-clip (every release incl. 2.0.1), klein-9b-lora-headswap (a paid Flow package names it, live). Audit script: research/r2_audit.py.
